title: 🏛️ Ann Arbor ICPOC Sept 29 meeting: agenda, access, public comment
text:
21 hours ago 🏛️ The Independent Community Police Oversight Commission (ICPOC) will meet on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 6:00 PM in the City Council Chambers, 2nd floor, Larcom City Hall, 301 E. Huron St., Ann Arbor, MI 48104 .
You can watch live on CTN Channel 16 , ATT Channel 99 , or online at a2gov.org/watchCTN . Public comment is allowed in person or by phone at 877-853-5247 or 888-788-0099 , using Meeting ID: 935 1520 9819 . Comments are limited to 3 minutes per speaker .
The commission will handle basic business first: roll call, approving the agenda, and approving minutes from the May 2026 regular and special meetings ( items 26-0912 and 26-0913 ). Then they will hear the Chair’s Report (item 26-1638) dated September 29, 2026 .
Under new business, they will talk about 2026–2027 committee assignments , a monthly leadership meeting , and get a 2026 NACOLE conference update.
Committee reports will come from the Policy, Training, Outreach, Recruitment-Planning, and Information Manager Committees . The Outreach section includes item 26-0914, “Outreach Committee – Social Media.” A City Council update and a communications segment finish the agenda.
Anyone is welcome to participate. For translation, sign language, or other accommodations, contact the City Clerk’s Office at 734-794-6140 or cityclerk@a2gov.org , or write to City Clerk’s Office, 301 E. Huron St., Ann Arbor, MI 48104 . Requests made with less than two business days’ notice may not be possible to meet.
More Info: https://a2gov.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=8A436F13...
